name: Ragnorra, True Mother

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: Creatures larger than Medium take up more than 1 square. For instance, an ogre takes up a space that is 2 squares by 2 squares. Most Large and larger creatures also have a reach greater than 1, which means they can make melee attacks against creatures that aren’t adjacent to them. A creature’s basic body shape usually determines its reach; a Large ogre has a reach of 2, but a Large horse has a reach of 1.

traits.name: Corruption
traits.details: any creature that enters or starts its turn in the aura takes 20 necrotic damage.

auras.name: Corruption
auras.details: any creature that enters or starts its turn in the aura takes 20 necrotic damage.

effect.description: Ragnorra moves its speed and can move through enemies’ spaces. When it enters and enemy’s space Ragnorra makes the following attack: +33 vs. Reflex; 2d10 + 9 and the target is knocked prone. Ragnorra must end this move in an unoccupied space, but can make a melee basic attack at the end of this move;

powers.name: True Mother Chord
powers.description: the target is dazed and takes ongoing 5 damage (save ends both)

attacks.name: Hit
attacks.targets: targets up to 4 enemies in the burst

aftereffects.name: Aftereffect
aftereffects.description: the target is dazed and takes ongoing 5 damage (save ends both)

powers.name: Reflect Power
powers.trigger: when missed by a power that attacks against Fortitude, Reflex, or Will

effect.description: Ragnorra reflects a portion of the power back onto the character who attacked her; that character takes 20 damage of the same type as the attack.
